blocks.text: HOARDING CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Hoarding Cleanouts in Port Perry

items.q: How much does a hoarding cleanout cost in Port Perry?
a: Hoarder clean out cost depends on how many rooms are affected and how much sorting the belongings need — never on the property’s location. A single room prices modestly, a full home with generations of accumulation costs more given the time required. The figure is confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: Is there really no extra charge for waterfront or Scugog Island properties?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at a downtown backyard and at a shoreline property on the island — no distance fee, no seasonal surcharge, no exceptions.

items.q: Our home has real antiques mixed in with everything else — how do you handle that?
a: With real care. Pieces that look like they carry genuine value get set aside for a proper look rather than swept into a general donation pile along with everything else. The sorting slows down specifically where that judgment matters.

items.q: Can you work around seasonal access to an island or waterfront property?
a: Yes — tell the crew your property’s rhythm at the walkthrough and the visit gets planned around it, at the same flat price as anywhere else in the township.

items.q: What's the best way to clean out a hoarder's house?
a: Professional help, a clear plan, and patience. Going in without a strategy usually causes more distress than progress. The most effective approach sorts systematically — keep, donate, recycle, dispose — and moves at a pace the household can genuinely handle.
